items.name: OneInterface/stormy-cookbook
items.full_text: Open-source cookbook for the Stormy Social Data API and MCP server (Model Context Protocol) — one REST API for the TikTok API, YouTube API, Instagram API, LinkedIn API, X (Twitter) API and Reddit API. Search creators, resolve profiles, read posts and find verified emails from Claude, Cursor, Codex, ChatGPT or curl. One key, no scrapers.
